items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: I had a band in Pete Herman's and when the war came out I left to go to work in a shipyard. I left Pete Herman's. And I did him a very nice favor by putting all four F-men on the job and left.

ctx.x: When did you go into Pete Herman's?

Well, the first, I worked at Pete Herman three different times. The first time when I went to New York he wanted me to put a band in his place and I told him I was all set to go to New York. But when I came back, 1940, I had a band in Pete Herman's and when the war came out I left to go to work in a shipyard. I left Pete Herman's. And I did him a very nice favor by putting all four F-men on the job and left. You know, fellas that wouldn't be called into the draft. Like Irwin Dennis who weighed almost 300 pounds,…
